mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 50 degree temperatures at Fireman's Park with a third quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City residents should be aware that alternate-side parking rules begin November 20 to assist with snow removal, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is a busy schedule ahead, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and several trivia nights coming up this Tuesday, November 4, and Wednesday, November 5.
Looking at the weekly report, on Sunday, October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old local man for O W I after locating him stationary at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
